text: OpenAI announces $110B financing led by Amazon ($50B), Nvidia ($30B), and SoftBank ($30B), raising pre-money valuation to $730B. AWS partnership expands by $100B over eight years. Company targets large-scale GPU capacity and outlines long-term compute spend projections.

meta.note: Capital scale materially exceeds prior round; investment structured with staged commitments.

text: Core producer price index increases 0.8% month over month and 3.6% year over year, above consensus. Headline PPI rises 0.5% monthly and 2.9% annually. Services prices advances 0.8% while goods decline 0.3%. Equity futures extend losses following release.

meta.note: Goods and services diverge within aggregate; market reaction contemporaneous with data release.

text: Dell reports $33.38B quarterly revenue and $3.89 adjusted EPS, both above estimates, and guides FY2027 revenue to $138B-$142B versus $124.7B expected. AI server revenue projected at $50B in 2027. Memory shortages raise input costs across PCs while price increases are implemented.

meta.note: Component scarcity persists alongside revenue expansion; price elasticity effects not yet observed.

text: President Donald Trump says no final decision has been made on potential military action against Iran. U.S. Embassy in Jerusalem authorizes departure of non-emergency personnel. USS Gerald Ford arrives off Israel's coast. Diplomatic meetings with Omani and Israeli officials scheduled.

meta.note: Military positioning and diplomatic talks coexist; no authorization of force announced at time logged.
